sources.title: Distilling Step-by-Step! Outperforming Larger Language Models with Less Training Data and Smaller Model Sizes
sources.relevance: Task-specific rationale-plus-label supervision can outperform larger models in the paper settings; this does not establish ARGOS success or general teacher superiority.

sources.title: PaD: Program-aided Distillation Can Teach Small Models Reasoning Better than Chain-of-thought Fine-tuning
sources.relevance: Program-based filtering of reasoning data motivates verifiable targets. The present run does not implement the paper complete PaD algorithm.

sources.title: Let's Verify Step by Step
sources.relevance: Process supervision motivates attention to intermediate errors; the present experiment uses completion-only SFT of verified explanation text, not a trained process reward model.
